newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico October retail, wholesale sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Mexico October retail, wholesale sales rise.

text.p: Mexico's retail sales rose 2.1 percent in October over the same month last year, the Mexican statistics institute INEGI said on Wednesday.
The institute said that wholesale sales rose by 6.2 percent in October compared to the same month a year earlier.
The INEGI report also said that purchases by retailers rose 4.8 percent in October over the same month a year earlier.
Purchases by wholesalers rose 9.4 percent in the same period, it said.
The agency said that wholesale sales rose in 23 of 33 cities monitored, while retail sales rose in 21 of those cities.
In retail sales in October increases were seen in vehicle sales, gas companies, spare parts for vehicles, and furniture and others.
In wholesale trade, increases were seen in vehicles, construction materials, spare parts for vehicles and electrical equipment for industry and househoulds, among other sectors, the agency said.
